questions.question: Which clinical domain has the highest number of measure records in the 2023 Core Set dataset?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('medicaid_child_adult_quality_measures_2023.csv')
result = df['Domain'].value_counts().idxmax()

questions.question: In the 2023 dataset, does the Child Core Set have more total reported records than the Adult Core Set?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('medicaid_child_adult_quality_measures_2023.csv')
child_count = (df['Reporting Program'] == 'Child Core Set').sum()
adult_count = (df['Reporting Program'] == 'Adult Core Set').sum()
result = 'yes' if child_count > adult_count else 'no'

questions.question: What was Wyoming's cervical cancer screening rate (CCS-AD) for Medicaid and dual eligible adults in the 2023 Adult Core Set?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('medicaid_child_adult_quality_measures_2023.csv')
subset = df[(df['State'] == 'Wyoming') & (df['Measure Abbreviation'] == 'CCS-AD') & (df['Population'] == 'Medicaid & Dual Eligibles')]
result = float(subset['State Rate'].iloc[0])

questions.question: In Alabama's 2023 Child Core Set reporting, how many more emergency department visits per 1,000 beneficiary months (AMB-CH) were recorded for the Medicaid-only population compared to the CHIP-only population?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('medicaid_child_adult_quality_measures_2023.csv')
medicaid_rate = float(df[(df['State'] == 'Alabama') & (df['Measure Abbreviation'] == 'AMB-CH') & (df['Population'] == 'Medicaid only')]['State Rate'].iloc[0])
chip_rate = float(df[(df['State'] == 'Alabama') & (df['Measure Abbreviation'] == 'AMB-CH') & (df['Population'] == 'CHIP only')]['State Rate'].iloc[0])
result = round(medicaid_rate - chip_rate, 2)
